title: Crop Insurance Premium Rate, Federal Subsidy and Administrative Fee Table
content:
Premium rates, federal premium subsidies and the administrative fee for Crop Insurance are fixed per plan and coverage level as follows.

| Plan and coverage level | Base premium rate (% of liability) | Subsidy, basic or optional units | Subsidy, enterprise units | Beginning farmer extra subsidy | Administrative fee per crop per county | Beginning farmer pays no administrative fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) | 0.0% | 100% | 100% | 0 points | $655.00 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 65% Coverage | 2.15% | 59% | 80% | 10 points | $30.00 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 70% Coverage | 2.9% | 59% | 80% | 10 points | $30.00 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 75% Coverage | 4.05% | 55% | 77% | 10 points | $30.00 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 80% Coverage | 5.7% | 48% | 68% | 10 points | $30.00 | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 85% Coverage | 8.45% | 38% | 53% | 10 points | $30.00 | Yes |

## Column definitions

1. **Base premium rate** — Total premium as % of liability for the county reference crop and practice (the rate table applied by the provider).
2. **Subsidy, basic or optional units** — Federal premium subsidy for basic or optional units, % of total premium.
3. **Subsidy, enterprise units** — Federal premium subsidy for enterprise units, % of total premium.
4. **Beginning farmer extra subsidy** — Additional subsidy percentage points for a beginning farmer or rancher.
5. **Administrative fee** — Administrative fee per crop per county, USD.
6. **Beginning farmer pays no administrative fee** — whether a beginning farmer or rancher pays no administrative fee.

## Footnotes to the table

- At every Revenue Protection level the enterprise-unit subsidy is the higher of the two subsidy columns: 80% against 59% at 65% and 70% coverage, 77% against 55% at 75%, 68% against 48% at 80%, and 53% against 38% at 85%.
- The base premium rate rises with the coverage level, from 2.15% at Revenue Protection 65% Coverage to 8.45% at Revenue Protection 85% Coverage; Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) carries a rate of 0.0% and a subsidy of 100% under either unit column.
- The beginning farmer extra subsidy is stated in percentage points: at Revenue Protection 75% Coverage on basic or optional units, the 55% subsidy and the 10 extra points together make 65 points for a beginning farmer or rancher.
- The administrative fee is $655.00 per crop per county at Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) and $30.00 at every Revenue Protection level; at every level a beginning farmer or rancher pays no administrative fee.
